svg.text: Old values compared to the new arena tuning. Only changed numbers are shown inside each card.
Focus now adds Crit Chance +0.4% per stack
Stack damage and stat scaling retuned
Damage-over-time effects were toned down, while control and stat-swing effects became sharper.
Focus is now the only status effect that directly increases crit chance: +0.4% per stack.
Use this sheet as the quick old-to-new reference for champion item effect behavior.
